thread:
Maria: hey everyone, Maria here — just started and have my first on-call week. quick list of setup things i couldn't find and a couple of workflow q's.
Kevin: welcome Maria! :tada: ask away.
oncall-bot: PagerDuty integration: https://redwood.pagerduty.com/integrations (requires SSO). Contact IT if the SSO link errors.
Maria: thanks. first — i don't see PagerDuty in my integrations page. i ran the SSO flow but it failed at the 2FA step.
Kevin: odd. sometimes the SSO device pairing times out. can you try incognito and then ping me? if it still fails, open a ticket to #people-ops-it and tag @kevin.
Maria: got it. next: how do i trigger a simulated pager? i want to test my phone routing before i go live.
Jordan: we use the pdcli for sim tests. example:
```
pd trigger --service "ingest-service" --type simulated --summary "oncall smoke test"
```
That will generate a simulated incident visible in the PD web UI. note: use your @redwood email or it'll be ignored.
Maria: perfect. do simulated incidents follow the same escalation path as production?
Jordan: yes — sim uses the same escalation policy unless you pass `--override-policy`. escalation matrix is: primary -> 15m -> secondary -> 15m -> oncall-lead. short snippet:
```
Primary: @Maria
Secondary: @Kevin
Oncall lead: @Jordan
Escalation: 15m -> 15m
```
Olga: also check runbook access before you run sims. runbooks live in the runbooks repo and on Confluence. paths:
- Git: gitlab.com/redwood/runbooks/tree/main/ingest
- Confluence: /display/SRE/Runbooks
Maria: i couldn't find the ingest runbook in Confluence. gitlab link worked though. is there a recommended way to open edits/feedback on runbooks?
Olga: open a merge request in gitlab for small fixes, or add a comment on Confluence for bigger structural changes. prefix commits with `runbook:` so we can track changes in weekly ops review.
Maria: noted. second workflow Q — when we page, who gets cc'd in the incident Slack channel by default? and what's the doc expectation post-incident?
Kevin: default channel is #incidents/<service>. we don't cc product automatically. for severity >= Sev2, please @-mention the EM and CS lead. post-incident: create a postmortem within 72 hours using the template here: https://confluence/redwood/postmortem-template
Maria: thanks. is there a short checklist i can follow the first time i take a page (like a 5-step triage)?
Jordan: yup, quick checklist we hand out to new oncallers:
1) acknowledge in PagerDuty
2) skim the service runbook (top section)
3) check recent deploys (deploy-bot messages in #release-war-room)
4) collect key logs (see runbook commands)
5) notify EM if >15m to mitigation
Also we encourage a quick call with the oncall buddy if things look fuzzy.
Maria: where do i find the buddy schedule?
Kevin: buddy schedule is in the SRE handbook under "oncall buddies" or ping @sre-training to be assigned one for your first two shifts.
sre-training: assigning buddy... @Kevin will be your buddy for this week, @Jordan will shadow Fri night shift. We'll add you to the shadow calendar invite.
Maria: amazing, thank you. final Q — any quick commands i should memorize for runbook checks?
Olga: small list:
- check service health: `kubectl -n ingest get pods`
- tail logs: `stern ingest-service`
- runbook fetch: `curl -s https://runbooks.redwood/ingest/latest | head -n 100`
Maria: saved. i'll try a simulated page tomorrow morning at 10am PT — ok to do that?
Kevin: yep, go ahead. i'll be around to watch. :thumbsup:
Maria: cool, will ping here when i run it. thanks for the quick onboarding help!! :heart:
oncall-bot: Reminder: new oncall checklist completed? If not, visit https://internal.redwood/oncall-checklist
Maria: completed everything except the PD SSO, will follow up with IT. thanks all!"
